a helmet, front and rear lights (it's a dark-hours ride), water, a spare tube or patch kit, a way to pay for the stop.

Check
Look at the host's website the day of — that's where cancellations, weather calls and start changes get posted.

About the Major Taylor Cycling Club Little Rock Evening Ride group ride

Twice-weekly evening road ride from the Little Rock side of the Big Dam Bridge, run by the local Major Taylor club. Intermediate to advanced pace. Major Taylor clubs grew out of Black cycling communities and are open to all.
